title: Copy text after a click
summary: The Clipboard API can write text to the clipboard.
introduction: The Clipboard API can write text to the clipboard. Your task: Change the copied words to a different club name.

Explain the example for copy text after a click

blocks.text: The Clipboard API can write text to the clipboard. It normally needs a secure page and a deliberate user action.

Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

blocks.title: Copy text after a click

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`writeText` requests clipboard access for a text value. Keep a fallback for denied or unsupported access.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: On an allowed HTTPS or localhost page, the button copies Garden club. A failure shows a manual-copy message.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Clipboard support and permission vary. Keep a useful fallback.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the copied words to a different club name.
